integrity: The covariance entries follow by inclusion-exclusion. Positive definiteness for at least two draws is proved from positive-probability singleton and pair occupancy patterns. Strict inverse positivity is then proved directly by diagonal normalization and a nonnegative Neumann series. Exact-rational enumeration and matrix inversion are supplementary checks.
scientific_limitations: The inverse-positivity theorem is stated for finitely many positive category probabilities and iid draws.
The conclusion concerns covariance, precision, and linear partial correlation; it does not assert a corresponding sign for every nonlinear conditional association.
Older occupancy or matrix-analysis literature may contain the same inverse-positivity observation under Stieltjes-matrix or nonsingular M-matrix terminology.
title: Occupied-box indicators have a strictly positive precision matrix
